title: Reach 30 grams of fiber per day.
subtitle: Fiber floor
rationale: Push daily fiber toward the intake range with the strongest all-cause outcome data in nutrition.

evidence.summary: Systematic reviews and meta-analyses link 25-29-plus grams of daily fiber to lower all-cause mortality and cardiometabolic disease incidence.

sources.label: Carbohydrate quality systematic reviews and meta-analyses

indications: The default diet centers on protein and refined carbohydrate.
Fiber intake is untracked and probably under 20 grams.
Cholesterol or glucose markers are drifting upward.
